MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #7
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MARINE AND FISHERIES TECHNOLOGY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.

2. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Morphology and Anatomy? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Morphology and Anatomy.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Morphology and Anatomy.

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish Pond? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Pond.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish Pond.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish Pond.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish Pond.

5. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Removing all vegetation
   B. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   C. Burning crop residue every week
   D. Overgrazing continuously

6. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water removes heat too quickly

7. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 50 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 0 °C
   D. 37 °C

8. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Movement of water only across a membrane
   B. Heating until a solid melts
   C. A chemical reaction forming ash
   D. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

9. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture of two liquids
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. Any substance that conducts electricity
   D. Any white crystal used in cooking

10. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. newton (N)
   B. pascal (Pa)
   C. joule (J)
   D. watt (W)

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 ? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .

12. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   B. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fish Pond and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of capture fisheries 3.2 Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of  and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Safety and Survival Techniques Page 15 of 34 1 STRAND 1.0: FISH BIOLOGY AND ECOL and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Capture Fisheries.

2. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Morphology and Anatomy.

3. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fundamentals of Marine and freshwater fisheries Technology 1.2 Fish morphology a.

4. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish Pond.

5. B — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

6. B — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

7. B — 100 °C

8. D — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

9. B — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

10. A — newton (N)

11. C — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Fish morphology and anatomy 2.0 Aquaculture 2.1 Fundamentals of Aquaculture 2.2 .

12. B — Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
